mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_thread t WHERE t.author_account_id=#{accountId} AND t.deleted=0) AS threadsCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment c WHERE c.author_account_id=#{accountId} AND c.deleted=0) AS commentsCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.likes_count),0) FROM forum_thread t WHERE t.author_account_id=#{accountId} AND t.deleted=0) AS likesReceived, (SELECT 100+COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.change_points>0 THEN p.change_points ELSE 0 END),0) FROM forum_point_log p WHERE p.account_id=#{accountId}) AS totalPoints, (SELECT COALESCE(m.experience,0) FROM forum_member m WHERE m.account_id=#{accountId}) AS experience

SELECT CAST(m.account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId,m.username,m.nickname,m.points,CAST(m.avatar_attachment_id AS CHAR) AS avatarAttachmentId, COALESCE(m.experience,0) AS experience, 100+COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.change_points>0 THEN p.change_points ELSE 0 END),0) AS totalPoints FROM forum_member m LEFT JOIN forum_point_log p ON p.account_id=m.account_id GROUP BY m.account_id ORDER BY m.points DESC,totalPoints DESC,m.account_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(m.account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId,m.username,m.nickname,m.points,CAST(m.avatar_attachment_id AS CHAR) AS avatarAttachmentId, COALESCE(m.experience,0) AS experience, 100+COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.change_points>0 THEN p.change_points ELSE 0 END),0) AS totalPoints FROM forum_member m LEFT JOIN forum_point_log p ON p.account_id=m.account_id GROUP BY m.account_id ORDER BY experience DESC,totalPoints DESC,m.points DESC,m.account_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM forum_thread WHERE author_account_id=#{accountId} AND deleted=0 AND kind=#{kind} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
